query: Hi there, I just wanted to say I tried the new matcha shortbread cookies I ordered from your snack section last week and they’re so good, I already placed another order for three boxes to give to my coworkers. Oh also, my neighbor asked me to ask if you’ll restock the lemon scented dish soap you had on sale last month, she uses it all the time and couldn’t find it on the site anymore. Oh and my cat knocked over a mug on my desk this morning and spilled coffee all over my mousepad, I had to go dry it off with a hair dryer, what a mess. Anyway, I need to cancel two of my pending orders please, order #W5056519 and order #W5995614, both were ordered by mistake.
